_comment: Maps each .ds export to its Zoho Creator link name. A link name cannot be derived
from an export - it is fixed when the app is created and often differs arbitrarily
from the display name ('Peets Coffee Rewards' -> 'test-peets-new') - so this file is
the only place the mapping can live. codebase.js works without it, reporting
linkName as null. Verified against the live account on 03-Sep-2026.
linkName is the REST form, hyphenated - it is what the zoho_creator_* tools take as
appLinkName. Deluge cross-app references use the same name with hyphens replaced by
underscores (test-peets-new -> test_peets_new), since hyphens are not valid in an
identifier; codebase.js derives that form itself, so do not store it here.
externalApps lists apps that the exported Deluge calls into but which are NOT in
this folder, so a cross-app call can still be named rather than reported as unknown.

Peets_Coffee_Rewards.ds.note: Peet's hub: customers, points ledger, cart/order, mobile API gateway.

Peets_Product_Catalogue.ds.note: Peet's catalogue: products, modifiers, price lists.

Krispy_Kreme.ds.note: Krispy Kreme hub - a fork of the Peet's app, frozen before the _V2 work.

Product_Catalogue.ds.note: Krispy Kreme's catalogue, despite the unprefixed display name.

Restaurant_Management.ds.note: Krispy Kreme's restaurant app, despite the unprefixed display name.

Global_Configuration.ds.note: Markets, currency and nationality master data.

Loyalty_Engine_Handler.ds.note: Brand router: dispatches loyalty calls to a Peet's app or to Krispy Kreme.

peets-coffee1.note: Live app, NOT exported here. loyaltyEngineExecutionCall routes brand 1 to it, so the Peet's loyalty entry point does not run the Peets_Coffee_Rewards (test-peets-new) source in this folder. Export it before trusting any brand-1 trace.

peets-coffee.note: Live app, not exported. Named as a demo//old copy.
